_notes.encoding: Same 7-value scheme as poplar_b4t_2car (170/100/130/75/220/0/255), not the Devin-standard scheme used by poplar_1/poplar_b4f_3gil
_notes.mask_format_note: Original masks were saved palette-indexed (P mode, raw indices {0,35,85,125,155,180,255} via an inverted grayscale palette). Converted to plain 8-bit grayscale (L mode) via PIL's palette-resolving .convert('L') so stored pixel values match the visual/semantic values directly, consistent with every other mask in this dataset. Originals kept in masks/.bak_palette_originals/.
_notes.value_100_130: Adaxial_Epidermis (100, top band) + Abaxial_Epidermis (130, bottom band) → Epidermis (class 1), same pattern confirmed for poplar_b4t_2car
_notes.value_75_220: Bundle_Sheath (75, outer ring around a vein) + Vascular_Tissue (220, inner core of a vein) → Vascular_Region (class 2), same pattern confirmed for poplar_b4t_2car
_notes.mask_check: Verified converted mask pixel values across all 6 slices = {0, 75, 100, 130, 170, 220, 255}, image size 1011x318
_notes.facility_beamline: Canadian Light Source, Biomedical Imaging and Therapy - Bending Magnet (BMIT-BM 05B1)
_notes.detector: PCO Edge 5.5 sCMOS with LSO:Tb scintillator (10 um)
